$comment: Deviation registry. Gate B reads this. An UNAPPROVED deviation on a frame BLOCKS that frame — a low pixel diff can never override it. Add a deviation the moment you make one; never after the fact.

deviations.summary: Geist Sans/Mono retained instead of the spec's system font stack
deviations.reason: The system stack renders as SF Pro on iOS and Roboto on Android — two different products. Sizes, weights and tracking follow the spec exactly.

deviations.summary: design-system.md §12.1 reversed: ambient wash allowed app-wide, mascot allowed on working screens
deviations.reason: The v9 spec reverses two Phase-2.6 rules. Its own mascot law bans Odo only from money and safety surfaces.
The v9 nav is 4 tabs plus the orb in every frame. No route removed.

deviations.summary: WebAuthn descoped pre-launch; frame 06 out of scope
deviations.reason: Browser inconsistency and support burden outweigh the MVP security delta.

deviations.summary: Clinic creation kept as 3 steps; the frame shows a single screen
deviations.reason: The single screen drops hours and profile capture. Feature parity outranks fidelity.
The page has always used the native keyboard; building a pad adds a surface rather than migrating one.

deviations.summary: /more shows 3 module tiles for a doctor, not 4
deviations.reason: canAccess('/billing','DOCTOR') is false. Rendering it would leak a permission.

deviations.summary: /lab/new kept as a page; the frame shows a sheet
Patient detail keeps 5 tabs (Media has no frame)
deviations.reason: Feature parity — Media must not disappear.

deviations.summary: Mascot rendered on /role; frame 07 has none
deviations.reason: Introduced without cause during migration and never flagged.

deviations.summary: /role used tap→navigate; frame 07 is select→sticky CTA "Continue as doctor"
deviations.reason: A different interaction model, shipped unflagged.

deviations.$comment: 13 onward: found by the first Gate B criteria review. Split deliberately — a PRODUCT DECISION needs your ruling; an INCOMPLETE MIGRATION is a defect its owning task must fix and is tracked in findings.json, not here.
deviations.summary: Phone number masked to "+91 ••••• 0001"; frame 04 shows it in full
deviations.reason: Shoulder-surfing protection on a screen a patient may see. A product decision, not a styling slip — so it needs your ruling rather than a silent revert.

deviations.summary: An explicit "Verify" button; frames 04/05 auto-submit on the sixth digit
deviations.reason: Accessibility fallback when SMS autofill does not fire, and a manual retry after a wrong code. The frame's title is literally "OTP — auto-read", so this is a real departure.

deviations.summary: Wrong code clears the six boxes and raises a toast; the frame keeps the digits and reports once, inline
deviations.reason: Not defensible as a product decision — the frame keeps the digits so the user can see and fix the typo, and reporting the same failure twice is noise. Recommend reverting to the frame.

deviations.summary: /welcome carousel has 4 slides with different copy; frame 02 is slide 1 of 3
deviations.reason: The frame's slide-1 copy ("Speak. Odovox writes the record.") is the product's opening promise. The app opens on a different pitch, left-aligned rather than centred, with a Skip link and language chips the frame does not have.

deviations.summary: /clinic-join captures the joiner's name; frame 09 has only the code field
deviations.reason: Feature parity — the join request records who is asking. Same class as deviations 6 and 10.

deviations.summary: The Odo mascot artwork is not the spec's #odo-body symbol
deviations.reason: The spec draws an outline tooth with lime blush ovals; the app draws a filled grey tooth with no blush. SYSTEMIC — it affects every frame Odo appears in, so it is one fix, not one per screen.
